FN-TBGCM51-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 423
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Jeremy Gray
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/17/2026
House Bill 423 as introduced would decrease sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by
an estimated $200,480 annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, based on information provided
by Goodwill Industries of Southern Rivers, Incorporated, by exempting this entity from paying
state sales and use taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales tax receipts to county and municipal funds, cumulatively, by
an estimated $263,120 annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, based on information provided
by the entity, if the respective local governments adopt an exemption from local sales and use
taxes, pursuant to this bill.
